verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that each Ubuntu release ships the latest applications, libraries, and toolchains, and that Ubuntu is a primary platform for all major IDEs and AI/ML software. Supporting docs cover NVIDIA driver installation and DKMS module builds, which matter for AI/ML, and WSL is pitched for running cutting-edge AI/ML tooling. Missing for 10: named IDEs or toolchains and concrete AI/ML frameworks beyond marketing-level claims, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the latest versions are actually available and supported.
